verdict.rationale: Attio has a public REST API with an OAuth flow for apps and an ATTIO_API_TOKEN for SDK server functions. However, nothing in the evidence says tokens can be scoped, restricted to least privilege, or issued specifically for an agent. The pricing page's "Permission controls" item is an adjacent workspace feature, not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
